summary: Frontend-only test of the new Media Gallery Picker feature (MediaPickerModal) across all 5 admin editor pages. Uploaded 2 test images to /admin/media, then verified every gallery button in scope: /admin/blog Cover Image (blog-gallery-picker-btn), /admin/portfolio Gambar Utama (portfolio-image-gallery-btn, single-select), /admin/portfolio Galeri Carousel (portfolio-gallery-picker-btn, multi-select), /admin/services Gambar Layanan (service-image-gallery-btn), /admin/services Landing Page Visual Hero (service-hero-gallery-btn), /admin/testimonials photo (testimonial-photo-gallery-btn), and /admin/appearance ImageField (image-field-gallery-btn). Search field (media-picker-search) filters correctly (filtered 2->2 on 'test'), close-via-X (media-picker-close) works, click-on-dark-overlay closes the modal without selecting, single-select clicks immediately populate the field and close the modal, multi-select toggles check marks without closing and appends all selected images to the carousel on confirm (media-picker-confirm shows 'Gunakan N Gambar' and appended 2 images into Galeri Carousel form state as expected). All test data cleaned up (2 uploaded test media deleted via /api/admin/media?id=). No bugs found. All data-testid attributes match the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: components/admin/MediaPickerModal.tsx: clean implementation. Resets selected/search/folderFilter on each open (good). Fetches /api/admin/media only when open flips true (good, no wasted requests). Overlay click closes; inner click stopPropagation prevents accidental close. Confirm button correctly disabled when selected.size===0.

components/admin/ImageField.tsx: dual upload + gallery UX is consistent across every editor. Consider forwarding `folder` prop to MediaPickerModal to auto-scope the folder filter (currently the picker shows ALL folders regardless of the field's expected folder). Not a bug, just a small UX polish.
app/admin/portfolio/page.tsx: multi-picker onSelectMultiple correctly appends (does not replace) to form.images. Good.
MediaPickerModal has no keyboard-close (ESC) handler. Minor a11y improvement opportunity, not required.
The gallery picker fetches the FULL media list every time it opens. For >500 images this could get slow (no pagination on GET /api/admin/media). Consider adding server-side pagination + search later.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded 2 tiny JPEG test images (test1.jpg red, test2.jpg blue) to /admin/media during the run; ALL cleaned up after testing (verified media count back to 0 via /api/admin/media).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Media Gallery Picker feature is fully working across all 5 editors + ImageField. Testids stable: media-picker-overlay, media-picker-item-<id>, media-picker-search, media-picker-close, media-picker-confirm, blog-gallery-picker-btn, portfolio-image-gallery-btn, portfolio-gallery-picker-btn, service-image-gallery-btn, service-hero-gallery-btn, testimonial-photo-gallery-btn, image-field-gallery-btn. If retesting, remember to wait_for_selector on media-picker-item-* AFTER opening the modal (fetch is async, count is 0 for ~200ms). DELETE endpoint uses query param: /api/admin/media?id=N (NOT /api/admin/media/N).
